answer: Witnessed Physical Presence Receipts. Each identity registers at a fixed knoll site where an agent must appear in person at dawn to collect a hardware-rooted, time-bound receipt signed by an on-site witness; the receipt binds a device key to a location and date, and only one receipt is issued per device per cycle. At a jetty checkpoint, receipts are re-verified against witnessed logs. Faking requires physically staffing every site, every dawn, with distinct devices — a per-identity cost of real travel, staffing, and hardware, all observable.
